# ARK Experience (ARKE)

> Digital guides for natural body care you can make at home, by Yana in Phuket, Thailand. Tested formulas explained in plain language, for curious beginners who would rather make something with their hands than scroll.

ARK Experience is a personal project that shares educational PDF guides. Each formula is made and used daily by Yana, her family and friends in Phuket's year-round heat. Formula amounts and percentages are only inside the guides. The guides are for education and personal use, not medical advice.

## Free guides

- [Beginner's Guide to Natural Body Care](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-beginners): 16 pages on reading ingredient labels, what natural means, seeing through claims and myths, and taking a first step into making your own body care.
- [Making Natural Lip Balm at Home](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-lip-balm): 15 pages with one tested lip balm formula, explained ingredient by ingredient. Twenty minutes, twenty tubes.

## Paid guides (instant PDF, one-time payment)

- [Natural Deodorant Guide](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-deodorant) (USD 14.99): a baking-soda-free natural deodorant stick, tested daily in Phuket's heat and explained ingredient by ingredient.
- [Shampoo Bars Guide](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-shampoo-bars) (USD 15.99): gentle solid shampoo bars made without lye, with one tested rosemary and calendula formula, explained phase by phase.
- [Whipped Body Butter Guide](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-body-butter) (USD 13.99): whipped body butter made at home, with the science of butters, oils and wax and the cooling and whipping technique.
- [Oil Infusions for Hair & Body](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-oil-infusions) (USD 12.99): infusing botanicals into oil for hair and body, with every method, drying, straining, storage and two ARKE formulas.

## Blog articles

- [Why I Make My Deodorant Without Baking Soda](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/deodorant-without-baking-soda): Baking soda fights odor well, but it's very alkaline, and some underarms don't get along with it. Redness, itching or a stinging rash are the usual complaints. I make my deodorant without it. Moisture absorbers handle the wetness, and gentler ingredients keep odor in check.
- [Natural Deodorant in Hot, Humid Weather](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/natural-deodorant-hot-weather): Yes, natural deodorant can work in hot, humid weather if you expect it to control odor rather than stop sweat. The formula needs enough moisture absorbers and a texture that stays firm in the heat. Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin.
- [Why Is My Body Butter Grainy? How to Fix It](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/why-is-my-body-butter-grainy): Grainy body butter happens when butters like shea cool slowly or unevenly. Their fats set at different temperatures and form small crystals that feel like sand. You can usually fix a batch by melting it fully, keeping it warm for a while and then cooling it quickly.
- [How to Make Rosemary Oil for Hair at Home](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/how-to-make-rosemary-oil-for-hair): Rosemary oil for hair is usually an infused oil. You steep dried rosemary in a carrier oil, either slowly for about a month or gently with heat in a double boiler, then strain it and store it in a dark bottle. You need no special equipment.
- [How to Read a Skincare Ingredient Label](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/how-to-read-skincare-ingredient-labels): Skincare labels list ingredients by their INCI names, from the largest amount to the smallest. Anything at one percent or less can appear in any order at the end. Learn that rule, a handful of common names and what fragrance stands for, and most labels start to make sense.
- [Is DIY Skincare Safe? The Habits I Keep](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/is-diy-skincare-safe): DIY skincare can be safe when it's well formulated and made with care. Water-free products like oils, balms and butters are the simplest to make at home. Anything with water needs a preservative. Always patch test, use clean tools, label your batches and change one thing at a time.
- [Hands-On Hobbies to Reduce Screen Time](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/hobbies-to-reduce-screen-time): The hobbies that pull you away from screens best are hands-on ones with a finished result, like cooking, pottery, gardening, knitting or making your own body care. They keep your hands busy, give you something to show for your time and are hard to do while scrolling.
- [Can You Make Shampoo Bars Without Lye?](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/shampoo-bars-without-lye): Yes. A shampoo bar made with gentle cleansers instead of lye is called a syndet bar, short for synthetic detergent. It isn't soap at all. You melt and mix the ingredients, press them into a mold and never handle lye. A syndet bar works much like a liquid shampoo in solid form.
- [Body Butter vs Lotion vs Body Oil](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/body-butter-vs-lotion-vs-oil): Lotion is water and oil held together by an emulsifier, so it feels light and always needs a preservative. Body butter is butters and oils with no water, so it's richer and simpler to make at home. Body oil is a blend of oils, the easiest to make and lovely on damp skin.
- [How Long Do Herb-Infused Oils Last?](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/how-long-do-infused-oils-last): A well-made herb-infused oil for skin or hair usually keeps from several months to about a year, and the carrier oil decides most of that. Dried herbs, clean straining and a cool, dark bottle help it last longer. If it smells sharp, like crayons or old nuts, it's time to replace it.
- [What Does Natural Mean in Skincare?](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/what-does-natural-mean-in-skincare): In skincare, natural describes where an ingredient comes from, a plant or a mineral rather than a lab. It doesn't tell you whether a product is safe, gentle or effective. In most countries the word isn't legally defined for cosmetics, so the ingredient list matters more than the claim on the front.
- [Handmade Body Care Gifts for Friends](https://www.arkarkark.com/blog/handmade-body-care-gift-ideas): The easiest handmade body care gifts are lip balm, whipped body butter, infused body oil, natural deodorant and shampoo bars. They're quick to make in batches, keep well and feel personal. Add a label with the ingredients and the date, and a short note on how to use it.
